scope: full 2-torsion curves over F_{q^n}, q in {13,101}, n in {2,4,6}, 52 curves, 877 lines; research/lift_dense_conjugate_pair_20261106
statement: Conjugate-pair lines (one root in F_{q^(n/2)}, two roots Frobenius-conjugate) come from one F_q-linear system: 31 of 32 n=4 curves have exactly 6 such lines (one special curve has 19, a pencil), all 4 n=6 curves have 168 = 12(q+1); all 877 lines meet the orbit criterion, are all-lift or all-twist (449 all-lift), none is a descent line, no curve has j in F_{q^(n/2)}; on n=4 all-lift lines dead points (10/689, 3/4,242) and column collisions (75, 101) are at chance level.
